next.reason: 1985 'The END-STRING phrase delimits the scope of the STRING statement' (pointing to Scope of Statements). 2023 keeps optional END-STRING in the format (§2023:14.9.43.2), names it STRING's explicit scope terminator in Table 12 (§2023:14.5.1), and states its effect generally: it terminates 'the most-recently preceding unterminated statement having the statement-name for which that scope terminator is defined' (§2023:14.5.3.2 GR1) and 'any unterminated statements that appear between that statement-name and the explicit scope terminator' (§2023:14.5.3.2 GR2). Same scope delimitation.
